from.place: the tensor-product clause: the presheaf tensor product is defined sectionwise by F(U) tensor_{O(U)} G(U), and the sheaf tensor product is its sheafification

title: Tensor product of sheaves of modules on a site
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site, $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on
$\mathcal C$, and $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules. The
*presheaf tensor product* is

$$
 (\mathcal F\otimes_{p,\mathcal O}\mathcal G)(U)
 =\mathcal F(U)\otimes_{\mathcal O(U)}\mathcal G(U)
 \qquad(U\in\mathcal C),
$$

with the restriction maps induced by those of $\mathcal F$, $\mathcal G$ and
$\mathcal O$, and the *tensor product* $\mathcal F\otimes_{\mathcal O}\mathcal G$
is the sheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules associated to it (its sheafification).
For a morphism of sheaves of rings $\mathcal O_1\to\mathcal O_2$ and a sheaf of
$\mathcal O_1$-modules $\mathcal F$, the sheaf of $\mathcal O_2$-modules
$\mathcal F\otimes_{\mathcal O_1}\mathcal O_2$ is the *change of rings* of
$\mathcal F$. For $m\in\mathbf Z_{\geq1}$ the $m$-fold *tensor power* is
$\mathcal F^{\otimes_{\mathcal O}1}=\mathcal F$ and
$\mathcal F^{\otimes_{\mathcal O}(m+1)}
=\mathcal F^{\otimes_{\mathcal O}m}\otimes_{\mathcal O}\mathcal F$.

proof.text: The existing specialized monoidalCategory and tensorObjIsoSheafification identify the tensor of sheaves with sheafification of the sectionwise presheaf tensor. positiveTensorPower recursively uses that tensor. For independent ring and module universes the siteTensorPresheaf and siteSheafTensorRight constructions use the identical sectionwise tensor formula and module sheafification.

For exists_changeOfRingsMapMixedUniverses, view R2(X) and R2(Y) as modules over R1(X) and R1(Y) using alpha. Naturality of alpha and multiplicativity of R2(f) make R2(f) semilinear over R1(f). TensorProduct.map of this semilinear map with M.restrictₛₗ f gives the required underlying additive map. TensorProduct.induction_on proves R2(X)-linearity: zero and sums follow from additivity, and on s tensor m the assertion is exactly R2(f)(a*s) = R2(f)(a)*R2(f)(s). Its pure-tensor formula is definitional.

Classical.choose_spec gives changeOfRingsMap_tmulOfUniverses. Apply Mathlib ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.hom_ext to changeOfRingsMap_idOfUniverses and changeOfRingsMap_compOfUniverses. On generators 1 tensor m the formula reduces both assertions to the ring and module presheaf identity and composition laws. The restrictScalarsId and restrictScalarsComp comparisons are identity functions on underlying elements.

For changeOfRingsHom_naturalityOfUniverses, use ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.hom_ext, the restriction formula, and ExtendScalars.map_tmul. PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply for the original morphism identifies the module factors. Sheafification of the resulting presheaf morphism gives changeOfRingsHomOfUniverses.

For siteTensorRestriction_id, siteTensorRestriction_comp and siteTensorHom_naturality, reduce equality of module morphisms to their underlying linear maps with ModuleCat.hom_ext, and then to pure tensors with TensorProduct.ext'. The first two identities follow from PresheafOfModules.map_id and map_comp_apply; naturality follows from naturality_apply in the first tensor factor. The identity and composition laws for siteTensorHom follow sectionwise by the same tensor extensionality and reflexivity on generators.

Mathlib already supplies Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective and Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective for an isomorphism of presheaves. Apply these instances to the identity coefficient map. The forget, sectionwise tensor and sheafification functors then compose to the stated siteSheafTensorRight.

For cochainTensorLocalizationIsMonoidal, identify the existing Mathlib presheaf tensor with siteTensorPresheaf by identity section maps, checking restriction naturality on pure tensors. A local equivalence is locally injective and surjective. Apply the proved sheafification_tensorHom_isIso to its first-factor tensor map and the module localization criterion to recover membership in W. Transport along the tensor identification; the presheaf braiding gives left whiskering from right whiskering. Assemble IsMonoidal.

For colimit preservation, the existing localization sheafification L is monoidal. Its tensorator and the sheafification adjunction counit give a natural isomorphism L followed by tensorLeft M with tensorLeft M.val followed by L. The presheaf tensorLeft preserves coefficient-sized colimits, hence smallest-universe colimits, and sheafification is a left adjoint. Apply Mathlib Adjunction.preservesColimitsOfSize_iff for the fully faithful right adjoint. Right tensor colimit preservation follows from the symmetric braiding.

The preceding colimit preservation makes tensorLeft preserve binary biproducts in the additive category of module sheaves, hence makes it additive by Functor.additive_of_preservesBinaryBiproducts. The braiding transports additivity to tensorRight. Their map_zero and map_add laws are the four fields of cochainModulesPreadditive.
